full_judgment: 3. The defendant nos. 1,3 and 5 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying the material allegations _de. in the plaint and contending, inter alia, that the lands of C.S. Khatian No. 1207 i measuring 3.56 acres recorded as "Debttar Govinda Mohaprobo Jeo" in middle interest and Horendra Kishore Roy and others were owners of 8 annas and sechindra kumar Ray and others were owners of 8 annas share as Sebait. Diring C.S. operation, 2.66 acre of land has been recorded in the names of Satyendra Kumar and others is R.S. Khatian No. 1.145 out of 3.56 acres of land. The remaining lands were tenanted lands and were recorded in C.S. Khatian No. 1208, 1209 and 1212. One Gopal Das Mahanta was also C.S. recorded tenant in respect of 41 acres of land of plot No. 2673 and 2674 as recorded in C.S. Khatian No. 1210 under C.S. Khatian Nos. 1208 and 1209. The government acquired. 27 acre of land appertaining to plot No. 2373 for Roads and High Ways Department and the same has been recorded in the name of the Government in the R.s Khatian. The land of plot No. 2674 as described in the 'Kha' schedule is Bazar land and lands of plot No. 2963 was D.B. Road and thereafter included within the lands of said Bazar as the Roads and High Ways Department. There is no committee as the management committee of Sree Sree Govinda Mahaprobo Jeo andthe alleged committee has no sanction behind it. The alleged committee never performed any function relating to the Seba Puja of the Deity. The plaintiff has no prima facie case for any injunction as prayed for.
